fileUrls.title: File URLs
fileUrls.description: Direct links to PDF or image files (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, GIF, BMP, WebP). Max 50 MB each. Tip: upload files to an Apify key-value store and paste their record URLs.

languages.title: OCR languages
languages.description: Languages present in scanned pages. Pick only what you need; more languages = slower OCR.

mode.title: Extraction mode
enumTitles: Auto: text layer, OCR only scanned pages (cheapest)
mode.description: Auto is best for mixed documents.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Return extracted content as plain text or as Markdown (Markdown keeps tables).

extractTables.title: Extract tables
extractTables.description: Detect tables in digital PDFs and return them as rows (and Markdown tables).

includePageDetails.title: Include per-page details
includePageDetails.description: Adds a 'pages' array with text, method, tables and OCR confidence per page.

maxPagesPerFile.title: Max pages per file
maxPagesPerFile.description: Stop after this many pages of each file. Useful to cap cost on very long documents.

ocrDpi.title: OCR resolution (DPI)
ocrDpi.description: Higher = more accurate for small print but slower.
